info.name: Guava Voice Agent REST Conversations Messages API

items.docs: Send a single SMS from one of your Guava numbers.

params.name: to_number
params.description: The Guava number whose inbox you want to read (E.164). Must be owned by your organization.

params.name: start
params.description: Only return messages received at or after this time (ISO 8601, inclusive).

params.name: from_number
params.description: Only return messages sent from this number (E.164).

params.name: modality
params.description: Only return messages on this channel.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

items.docs: List the inbound messages received on one of your Guava numbers, oldest first.
